visualReview.notes: Inspected the narrow covered approach, low main roof, wall openings and west annex from Adelaide Street. The rear and yard views show the former ward, the separate ancillary buildings, water storage and aerial.

sharedSurfaceReview.notes: Inspected seam direction and shading on corrugated roof and wall cladding, the matt concrete apron, painted frames and glazed openings. The flat shared view crosses the low street apron. The original field shows the approach ramp grounded and rising to the entrance.

mediumFiReview.notes: All four levels retain the low gabled hip, covered walkway, the detached ward and simple site buildings. The higher levels add window and vent divisions, the former ward's open front verandah and the hospital aerial and gable vent.

geographicReview.notes: The named hospital outline and three other mapped footprints fit Queensland Heritage Register parcel 602635. The 256 m original Terrarium field shows the ground-to-floor transition at the Adelaide Street entrance and the relationship between the main building and the former ward behind it.

fidelityReview.scope: The 1953 Australian Inland Mission Hospital on its protected Birdsville parcel, with enclosed corrugated verandahs, the separate former Aboriginal ward, its service buildings, entrance walk and tanks.
fidelityReview.notes: The state register and architectural survey establish the prefabricated steel construction, corrugated cladding, enclosed verandahs, low hipped gable, covered walk and former ward. Roof pitch, window divisions, height and exact yard roles are estimates.

imageryReview.notes: Checked Qualla first. The opening photograph has a domestic expiry tag without a confirmed public-domain basis for this use. Other identified exterior photography carries attribution or share-alike terms. The authored geometry uses the native map, original terrain, and the register's factual text.

primaryFactsReview.notes: Queensland Heritage Register parcel 602635 and four native outlines establish the standing 1953 hospital yard. The registry description informs the prefabricated construction, enclosed verandahs, covered walkway, hipped gable and former ward. Elevations and smaller facade details are estimates.

validation.sharedCaptureScope: The standing 1953 Birdsville hospital, covered street access, former Aboriginal ward, detached ancillary buildings and water storage.

limitations: The native outlines and Queensland’s protected parcel fix the plan. Roof pitch, porch and opening heights, window divisions, and some outbuilding roles are approximations from the register’s written description.

The former ward is the southeastern mapped outbuilding. The register distinguishes its open front verandah and enclosed rear, and records hinged corrugated shutters. The two lesser yard structures are mapped and use simple forms.
The unchanged Terrarium field preserves the terrain context. Absolute heights and contact registration are approximate. No imagery was used for the reconstruction.
